title: Topiramate for alcohol use disorder: ClinicalTrials.gov posted results only
intro: Placebo-controlled trials of topiramate with a heavy-drinking outcome posted on ClinicalTrials.gov, as transcribed on 2026-10-14. The two pivotal Johnson trials posted no results and are not here.
